reason: policy: high-risk change (1 violation(s); require_approval by high_impact_paths)
summary: Spring Boot 3.4.5 URL shortener: create/redirect/metadata/delete with tombstones, destination policy, per-IP rate limit, file-based H2 + Flyway, health check
decisions: Persistence: File-based H2 under shortener.data-dir (./data) with Flyway V1 migration; Hibernate ddl-auto=validate (agent)
Deletion model: Soft delete into a tombstone row that keeps the code and erases original_url and token_hash, enforced by a CHECK constraint (agent)
Management token: 256-bit SecureRandom token, unpadded base64url, stored as SHA-256 hex, compared with MessageDigest.isEqual (agent)

Destination validation: Scheme, length and host checks, then resolve all addresses once at creation via an injectable HostResolver and fail closed on any prohibited address or resolution failure; fc00 (agent)

Rate limiting: Bucket4j (com.bucket4j:bucket4j_jdk17-core 8.14.0, on the allowlist) per network peer address, 20 per minute refilled intervally, every create attempt counts, forwarding headers not trusted (agent)
Reserved aliases: api, health, links, error, actuator, matched case-insensitively (agent)
Testability seams: Clock, SecureRandom and HostResolver are beans; shortener.data-dir and shortener.rate-limit.creates-per-minute are configurable (agent)
Timestamps: Instants truncated to microseconds before storing (agent)
